title: update note frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of one update note: a Markdown file under `packages/cli/update-notes/` (the base) or `modules/<name>/update-notes/` (a module) that tells the agent in a project what an upgrade asks of it beyond the files `saasaloy update` merges (#298). The note's id comes from its path, `base/NNNN-<slug>` or `<module>/NNNN-<slug>`, so the frontmatter carries none. The body holds four sections: "What update does", "What the merge plan gets", "What you do" and "Verify".

when.description: Ship this entry only while the condition holds (#242, ADR 0054). The keys combine with AND: `testing` ships it only when the project's testing mode is not `off`, and `installed` only when every named module is in the resolved install set. The applier tests it before `onlyWith`, and a target whose entries it drops is skipped, not refused. It decides the first write only: an entry already in the manifest stays managed in every mode. Backfill writes the entry once the condition turns true.

testing.description: Ship only when testing.mode is `tests-after` or `tdd`. The one allowed value is `true`; leave the key out for an entry that ships in every mode.

installed.description: Ship only when every named module is installed. `remove` of a named module also removes the entry.

title.description: One line that names the change, shown as the note's heading in the merge plan.

version.description: The CLI release that ships the change, as plain semver. Required on a base note, which `update` selects by CLI version range; absent on a module note, which `update` selects by the files in the module's `update-notes/` folder at the old and the new revision. The loader enforces both rules, because the schema cannot see the note's folder.
